answer: Locks are recorded in violet, expire in signal, and cipher lists each expiry. An farming party running 176 aliases hence needs 58 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2854 identities would post 3849 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
